title: Soundbar deals UK 2026: best Sonos, Bose, Sony and Samsung prices
seoTitle: Soundbar Deals UK 2026: Sonos, Bose, Sony and Samsung
description: The best soundbar deals in the UK this week, from a £194 Hisense surround kit to Sonos Beam and Arc Ultra, with good prices to aim for.
intro:
**Short answer: the best soundbar deal for most people is the Sonos Beam (Gen 2) at £339 at Amazon (was £449). On a tight budget, the Hisense AX5125H surround kit is £194, and for a big TV the Sonos Arc Ultra is down to £799.**

We picked eight soundbars across every budget, with prices reported on 24 and 25 November 2026. Each card links to the retailer, and non-Amazon picks also have a link to compare today's Amazon price.

body:
## Quick picks

- **Best overall: Sonos Beam (Gen 2) at £339.** It's compact, sounds clear and full, works with Alexa and AirPlay, and you can add a sub or rear speakers later.
- **Best cheap: Hisense AX5125H at £194.** You get a whole 5.1.2 surround kit for the price of a basic bar.
- **Best splurge: Sonos Arc Ultra at £799.** It's the best single bar for a large TV. If you want a full system with rear speakers, the Samsung HW-Q990H is £1,199.

All prices above were reported by What Hi-Fi, TechRadar, T3 and Expert Reviews on 24 and 25 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week. Most of these deals should last until Cyber Monday (30 November) but can end sooner.

## How to choose a soundbar

**1. Measure the space first.** A bar should be no wider than your TV and short enough not to block the screen or IR sensor. The Beam and Sony HT-S2000 suit 43- to 55-inch TVs. The Arc Ultra and Samsung Q990H look and sound best with 65 inches or more.

**2. Decide whether you want separate speakers.** An all-in-one bar (Beam, Bose Smart Soundbar, Sony HT-S2000) keeps things tidy. A system with a subwoofer and rear speakers (Hisense AX5125H, LG US80TR, Samsung Q990H) gives real surround sound and deeper bass, but needs space and power sockets at the back of the room.

**3. Check the connection.** Use the HDMI eARC (or ARC) socket on your TV so one remote controls the volume and the TV can pass Dolby Atmos through. Most TVs from the last five years have one. Optical works, but you lose Atmos.

**4. Don't overpay for Atmos.** Dolby Atmos adds height to films and some streaming shows, but on a small bar the effect is subtle. For speech and everyday TV, clear dialogue matters more, and that's where Sonos and Bose are strongest.

**5. Think about what else you use.** Sonos works with its own app and multi-room speakers. Bose and Amazon-friendly bars have Alexa built in. Samsung bars pair best with Samsung TVs (Q-Symphony uses the TV's speakers as well).

## Good prices to aim for

- **Sonos Beam (Gen 2):** £339 is a good Black Friday price. It sits around £449 full price.
- **Sonos Arc Ultra:** £799 is the same price it dropped to last Black Friday. Full price is £999.
- **Bose Smart Soundbar:** anything around £329 is good. Its recent average on Amazon is just over £400.
- **Budget 5.1 systems:** under £200 for a Hisense AX5125H is a fair price for a full surround kit.

If a "was" price looks high, ignore it and compare against these figures. Soundbars are discounted often, and launch prices rarely last.

## When are soundbars cheapest?

Black Friday Week (to 30 November) and Amazon's Prime Day in July usually bring the lowest prices. Sonos runs few sales, so Black Friday is the main chance for £100 to £200 off. Prices often creep back up in December and dip again in the Boxing Day sales.

A soundbar is the best upgrade for a new TV, as flat TVs have tiny speakers. See our [TV Black Friday deals](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) for screens to go with one, and our [Prime Video free trial guide](/guides/prime-video-free-trial-uk/) if you want something to watch on it. For more, browse [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## FAQs

### What's the best soundbar to buy in the UK?

For most people, the Sonos Beam (Gen 2). It's compact, has clear dialogue and Dolby Atmos, and is £339 at Amazon this week. For a big TV, the Sonos Arc Ultra at £799 is the step up.

### Is a soundbar with a subwoofer better?

For films, music and games, yes: a separate sub adds bass a slim bar can't. For mostly news, sport and dialogue, a good all-in-one bar like the Beam or Bose Smart Soundbar is enough and takes up less space.

### Will any soundbar work with my TV?

Almost any modern soundbar will work over HDMI ARC or eARC, or optical. Use HDMI eARC where you can, so the TV remote controls the volume and Dolby Atmos is passed through.

### Are Sonos soundbars on sale for Black Friday?

Yes. The Beam (Gen 2) is £339 (was £449) and the Arc Ultra is £799 (was £999) at Amazon, and the Sub Mini is £339. Sonos discounts rarely, so this is a good time to buy.

### When do soundbar deals end?

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Monday 30 November 2026. After that, the next big drop is usually the Boxing Day sales.
